title: Shanghai AI Lab Releases Sage-A1.5 to Beat Frontier AI in Science
summary:
A 35B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters now automates complex scientific workflows by spawning parallel subagents that self-correct on the fly. Released by Shanghai AI Lab, Sage-A1.5 is designed for long-horizon problem solving and hits 61.2% on the SWE-Bench Pro benchmark, outperforming frontier models on FS-Olympiad, FS-Research, CMT and PinchBench tests.

The model was developed using an RSI Data Flywheel that leverages real scientific discovery workflows and tens of thousands of synthesized environments. It features a 256k token context window and runs locally via vLLM, which provides Day-0 support, as well as SGLang, llama.cpp and LM Studio with a memory footprint of roughly 20GB for the Q4_K_M quantization.
